verdict.label: GNW two-genuinely-distinct-organs bus — production verify (real ChatBrain.gate, rf/cupy)

preconditions.name: backend-recognized
preconditions.note: get_backend() returned a known production backend for this invocation (this runner is invoked once per backend -- see the module docstring)

preconditions.name: production-chat-built
preconditions.note: the real production ChatBrain (webapp.server._build_chat_brain) built with the composer + stored_facts surface this runner reads

preconditions.name: install-off-is-noop
preconditions.note: flag OFF -> install_two_organ_gate is a no-op (proves the flag genuinely gates installation, a precondition for reading the flag-ON measurements below as attributable to the flag)

preconditions.name: install-on-installs
preconditions.note: flag ON -> install_two_organ_gate actually wraps chat.gate on the real production chat (proves the ON-path teeth below were measured on an installed coincidence, not a no-op)

preconditions.name: byte-identical-when-off
preconditions.note: wrapper installed but flag runtime-flipped OFF delegates to the ORIGINAL gate -> HEAD bytes (the runtime safety escape actually works, not just the install-time no-op)

preconditions.name: organ-discriminates-on-this-backend
preconditions.note: the pre-flight _organ_discriminates() gate reads True on this backend -- otherwise the ON-path teeth below would be measuring the safe-inert fallback, not the coincidence

preconditions.name: discrimination-hz-recorded
preconditions.note: agree/threshold/disagree Hz values were actually recorded (agree=0.4340277777777778 thr=1.4006438078703702 disagree=2.488425925925926) -- prerequisite for the discrimination teeth to mean anything

preconditions.name: safe-inert-fallback-works
preconditions.note: (N) the bus's OWN safety branch, verified via a stub with _organ_discriminates forced False: install_two_organ_gate returns False and never runs a mis-discriminating organ -- an instrument-level property of the mechanism, independent of whether THIS backend discriminates

disabled_processes.why: tested at the ChatBrain.gate/combine level where the 2-organ wiring actually lives, not the heavy numpy-CPU per-turn handler that steps every default-on organ each turn; byte-identical-when-off is guaranteed by construction there (the server hook is gated by the SAME flag)
